title: Fanout in a three-gate construction
statement: Let $u,N,o,v$ be nonnegative integers with $u<N$ and $o<N$. Form three gates in order: a NOT gate reading $u$, an OR gate reading $u$ and $N$, and an AND gate reading $o$ and $N+1$. The fanout of $v$ among these gates is $2$ if $v=u$, plus $1$ if $v=N$, plus $1$ if $v=o$, plus $1$ if $v=N+1$, with each contribution omitted when its stated equality fails.
